pageCache.text:
I am delighted to welcome you to our school website, where you can learn more about our academy, our curriculum, and our values.
We welcome children from the age of two in our nursery, providing a strong foundation for their educational journey. As they progress through the school, they learn in modern classrooms with excellent access to outdoor and shared learning spaces.
We also have a 28-place Alternative Provision that supports children from across Portsmouth. These children are dual-registered with their home school, and we work hard to provide tailored support for their social, emotional, and mental health needs.
I encourage you to explore our website to discover more about our vibrant school community or arrange a visit so you can see for yourself. I look forward to welcoming you and your family to The Flying Bull Academy.

Phonics and Early Reading
Phonics and Early Reading at The Flying Bull Academy
We are a ‘Little Wandle’ School!
Little Wandle is an accredited Synthetic Phonics Programme (SPP).
Information for parents including:
You can find our progression document for our phonics lessons here.
Videos to model the pronunciation of sounds
Reading Books at Home
Each week your child will bring home their Little Wandle reading book. This is a book that they have practised reading in school and can now read at home to build fluency with an adult. Children will also bring home a 'free choice' book. This book is for both adults and children to enjoy together. It is important to remember that this book is to be read to your child by an adult. Please ensure that your child brings their book bag into school daily, with their reading books and home reading journal inside.
Click here for more information about Phonics and Early Reading.
